nodes.name: Intelligence Layer Wiring Design
nodes.summary: Approved design (2026-06-04) for wiring HipCortex's three fully-implemented but disconnected intelligence modules (WorldModelEnhanced, AureusBridge, SelfModel, CoherenceChecker) into the REST server. Introduces AppState<B> struct to bundle all stores, adds 9 new REST endpoints for world-model/self-model operations, adds automatic memory-to-WorldModel feeding on every write, and specifies WorldModel JSON persistence with periodic flush and atomic rename. Also covers SelfModel bootstrap on startup and AureusBridge reflect endpoint design.

nodes.name: QueryMemoryResponse Full Field Exposure Design
nodes.summary: Approved design (2026-06-04) for extending MemoryRecordResponse with 7 missing fields (confidence, source, priority, tags, version, status, expires_at) that agent clients need to make intelligent retrieval and filtering decisions. Identifies the 4 construction sites in web_server.rs that must be updated and confirms backward compatibility since the change is purely additive.

nodes.name: Sim #11 P1/P2 Gap Closure Design
nodes.summary: Approved design (2026-06-04) closing 8 gaps identified in MiroFish Sim #11 (100-persona UAT of the intelligence layer). P1 gaps add REST endpoints for WorldModel state-space introspection (states, transitions, uncertainty), causal intervention and counterfactual reasoning, entity initial-state configuration, and a CoherenceChecker background auto-check task. P2 gaps add SelfModel can-execute query and runtime capability registration endpoints.

nodes.name: HipCortex Cohesive Gap Remediation Design
nodes.summary: Implemented 4-sprint design spec remediating critical architectural gaps in HipCortex against its S-Tuple Acceptance Criteria: Sprint 1 fixes silent math/API failures (Rollout API, causal SCM boundary, Kalman Joseph-form covariance, Merkle test correction); Sprint 2 introduces a polyglot CognitiveRecord<T> envelope and Hot/Cold tiered storage to prevent RAG search pollution; Sprint 3 adds provenance reachability tracing via a Cognitive Garbage Collector; Sprint 4 enforces the L0 Cognitive State Infrastructure boundary by extracting execution, consolidation, and planning logic to L4/L1/L2 layers.
nodes.languageNotes: References Rust-specific patterns (CognitiveRecord<T> generic envelope, Deref type aliases for backward compatibility, Joseph-form Kalman update) alongside Python test corrections; status field is IMPLEMENTED indicating all sprints were executed.
